response.sql: WITH signed AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, CASE t.type WHEN 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END AS signed_amount FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id), region_stats AS (SELECT region, AVG(signed_amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM signed GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_avg FROM region_stats), selected AS (SELECT r.region, r.avg_amount, r.txn_count FROM region_stats r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE r.avg_amount > o.mean_avg) SELECT AVG(s.avg_amount) AS mean_of_region_avgs, AVG(s.txn_count) AS mean_of_txn_counts, AVG(s.avg_amount - o.mean_avg) AS mean_excess_over_cross_mean FROM selected s CROSS JOIN overall o;

assumptions.assumption: Each transaction's region is the district.A3 of its account's branch district (account.district_id), not the client's district.

Signed amount is +amount for 'PRIJEM', -amount for 'VYDAJ' (amounts are stored unsigned, per the verified note). 'VYBER' and any other or NULL type get NULL, so AVG skips them, but they still count toward the transaction count.

The cross-region mean and the selection use only regions that have at least one credit or withdrawal. A region with no such rows has a NULL average and is dropped, since the request does not say how to treat it. This has no effect if every region has signed rows.

'Mean of the regional averages' is unweighted: each region counts once, regardless of how many transactions it has. The 'mean excess' is the average over selected regions of (region average minus cross-region mean).
